verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents its own API with an 'API Access & Keys' docs page, and a server /api endpoint is referenced in release notes. The evidence is only a page title, though, and nothing shows the API covers what the UI can do. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard docs paths, so the API's breadth cannot be verified. Missing for 10: evidence of UI/API feature parity (workspaces, documents, agents, admin/user management via API), a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on confirmation of API coverage.
